document.name: Dodge YMCA — Traditional Summer Camp (2026)
document.shortDescription: Dodge YMCA runs weekday summer camp in Downtown Brooklyn with traditional, kinder, swim, and Big Messy Art tracks for children ages 4 through 12.
document.longDescription:
The Dodge YMCA publishes 2026 summer camp at 225 Atlantic Avenue in Brooklyn, with two-week sessions running June 29 through August 21, 2026. The official page lists camp hours as 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. and extended hours from 8 a.m. to 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. to 6 p.m., which supports weekday morning, afternoon, and after-school tags.

The camp page lists Traditional Summer Camp for ages 5-10, Kinder Camp for ages 4-5, Swim Camp for ages 7-12, and Big Messy Art Camp for ages 6-8. Published descriptions highlight physical fitness, arts and crafts, science activities, group play, instructional swim, and a focused art camp with painting, clay sculpting, murals, and field trips.

Published community tuition for one two-week Traditional Summer Camp session is $956; Kinder Camp is listed at $1,043 community, Swim Camp at $1,073 community, and Big Messy Art Camp at $1,200 community. Camp leadership contact on the official page is Tsjaniqua Jeffrey at dodgeycamp@ymcanyc.org and 212-912-2414.

Sources: https://ymcanyc.org/locations/dodge-ymca/programs-classes/camps https://ymcanyc.org/locations/dodge-ymca https://ymcanyc.org/sites/default/files/styles/hero_banner_desktop/public/2025-12/2026_camp_stem.jpg.webp?itok=rXALosoc
